scope: A missing format specification is overextended into a claim that agreement has not occurred.

context.priorities: Understand whether this supplied PDF names a specific export file format or schema, and what to ask before arranging an export. Other transition issues are outside this focused review.

overview_items.text: Clause 36 refers to exports in agreed formats, including enough structural information to associate documents with identifiers, versions and recorded permissions.

findings.title: Export format particulars
findings.facts: Clause 36 refers to exports in agreed formats, including enough structural information to associate documents with identifiers, versions and recorded permissions.
findings.interpretation: No export format has been agreed, so the parties must negotiate one later.
findings.uncertainty: The supplied PDF does not identify a specific export file format or schema.
findings.suggested_question: Can the parties share the applicable format specification?

claim_issues.exact_claim: No export format has been agreed, so the parties must negotiate one later.
claim_issues.reason: Not finding format particulars in the supplied PDF does not establish no agreement elsewhere or a mandatory future negotiation; clause 36 already refers to agreed formats.

must_not_flag: Do not flag the narrowly scoped observation that this PDF does not name a file format or schema.
Do not treat a request for the applicable specification as asserting that a new negotiation is required.
